messages.subject: Error found in Part4 GGIR
parts:
Hi there,
I've encountered a new error in Part4 when processing the GENEActiv data set using sleep log data:
Error in if (WKN2 > SLN2) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I was able to get results for part of the data set using the same code and sleep log file though; so I wasn't sure if it has something to do with the sleep log data? 


Below is the code I am using as well as the screenshot of the sleep log file:
g.shell.GGIR(#=======================================
             #INPUT NEEDED:
             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
             datadir="C:/Users/khc745/Documents//Data_sleeplog/G",
             outputdir="C:/Users/khc745/Documents//Results_sleeplog/G",
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 1:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: reading file, auto-calibration, and extracting features
             do.enmo = TRUE, do.anglez=TRUE,desiredtz="Australia/NSW",
             chunksize=1, printsummary=TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 2:
             #-------------------------------
             strategy = 1,maxdur = 7,
             includedaycrit = 16,
             qwindow=c(0,24),
             mvpathreshold =c(192),
             bout.metric = 4,
             closedbout=FALSE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 3:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Sleep detection
             timethreshold= c(5), anglethreshold=5,
             ignorenonwear = TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 4:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Integrating sleep log (if available) with sleep detection
             # storing day and person specific summaries of sleep

             includenightcrit = 16,
             def.noc.sleep = c(),loglocation = "C:/Users/khc745/Documents/Baseline_sleeplog_G to M_VALID.csv",
             outliers.only = TRUE,
             criterror = 4,
             relyonsleeplog = FALSE,
             sleeplogidnum = FALSE,
             colid=1,
             coln1=2,
             do.visual=TRUE,
             nnights=7,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 5:
             # Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses
             #-------------------------------
             threshold.lig = c(52), threshold.mod = c(192), threshold.vig = c(696),
             boutcriter = 0.8, boutcriter.in = 0.9, boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1), timewindow = c("MM"),
             #-----------------------------------
             # Report generation
             #-------------------------------

             do.report=c(2,4,5),
